protocol.name: blockwork_seat_host_v1
protocol.description:
Offered by Blockwork's KWin plugin (blockwork-kwin/). Each lane is an extra wl_seat the compositor created at startup, with its own keyboard focus, pointer and modifiers. Binding a lane to a window sends that window keyboard enter and pointer enter on the lane's seat only, so the user's focus and pointer stay where they are.
Only clients outside a sandbox, or a sandboxed client whose app id is com.blockworked.Blockwork, may bind this global. Closing the connection releases every key and button the client's lanes hold.

request.name: get_lane
request.description: Takes a free lane. If none is free, the lane is sent refused(no_free_lane) and stays inert.

event.name: info
event.description: Sent once on bind. kwin_version is the KWin version the plugin was built against; lanes is how many seats it made at startup.

description.summary: one extra seat aimed at one window

entry.name: not_bound
entry.summary: the app never bound the lane's seat

entry.name: shared_focus
entry.summary: the app shares focus across windows and the user is in another of them

description.summary: release everything and give the lane back

request.name: bind

description.summary: aim the lane at a window

request.description: window is KWin's internal window id (a UUID, braces optional). Answered with bound once the app has made a keyboard and pointer on the lane's seat, or refused.

request.name: set_keymap

description.summary: the keymap the window sees for this lane

request.description: An XKB v1 text keymap. Until one is set the lane uses a US layout.

description.summary: press or release an evdev key code

request.name: motion
request.description: In logical pixels from the top left of the window's content.

description.summary: move by a delta, for apps that lock the pointer
press or release an evdev button code
scroll; value120 is one wheel notch per 120
let go of every key and button the lane holds

event.name: bound

description.summary: the lane is aimed at the window

event.description: width and height are the window content's logical size.

event.name: lost

description.summary: the lane can't reach its window any more

event.description: The lane has let go of everything and is unbound.

event.name: preempted

description.summary: the user used the same window

event.description: Physical input reached the lane's window. The lane keeps working; Blockwork waits a moment before its next input.
